verdict.rationale: Two-way Gmail/Outlook sync with automatic logging to records is a fair question for a CRM, but the evidence pack never documents it. The 'sync with over 500 tools, including Google' claim is a generic integration statement and does not describe email sync. Email campaigns are a different, outbound marketing feature.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records
